people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: When Jeremiah had finished speaking to all the people all the words of Yahweh their God, with which Yahweh their God had sent him to them, even all these words,
translations.bsb: When Jeremiah had finished telling all the people all the words of the LORD their God—everything that the LORD had sent him to say—
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking unto all the people all the words of the LORD their God, for which the LORD their God had sent him to them, even all these words,
translations.asv: And it came to pass that, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking unto all the people all the words of Jehovah their God, wherewith Jehovah their God had sent him to them, even all these words,
